<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    A composition workshop that complements and supports instruction in ENGL 1013 Composition I. 

May be repeated for credit. 

Note: The grade in ENGL 0303 will be recorded as pass or fail. The hours earned in ENGL 0303 may not be used to satisfy general education requirements nor provide credit toward any degree. A student who is placed in ENGL 0303 must register concurrently in an assigned section of ENGL 1013.
    
</section>
